description: Replace the character's face with Rimuru Tempest's ORIGINAL anti-magic mask from That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime. Smooth WHITE ivory mask, TWO dark gray flame-shaped markings, a bright RED DOT at the center, a THIN fixed curved dark line across the lower face with hooked ends. Closed solid mask, no teeth or eyes. Light blue bangs overlap its top. Keep the EXACT same south-facing pose, head size, hair, scarf, blue coat, hands and sword. Transparent 80x80 pixel art.
